# Bitmap fonts, generated by tools/gen_fonts.py from assets/fonts/*.ttf.
# Regenerate rather than edit: the .c files here are output.

file(GLOB FMSUI_FONT_SRCS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/*.c)

if(ESP_PLATFORM)
    idf_component_register(
        SRCS ${FMSUI_FONT_SRCS}
        INCLUDE_DIRS include
        REQUIRES lvgl
    )
else()
    add_library(fmsui_fonts STATIC ${FMSUI_FONT_SRCS})
    target_include_directories(fmsui_fonts PUBLIC include)
    target_link_libraries(fmsui_fonts PUBLIC lvgl)
endif()
